title: godetia roseoalba
intro: Godetia roseoalba, commonly known as the white godetia or white exaltation, is a flowering plant species in the evening primrose family (Onagraceae). It is native to the western United States and has been traditionally used in herbal medicine. The health benefits of Godetia roseoalba include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which may help to reduce inflammation, improve immune function, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
